LanguageData.SCP_354ObservedReport: Clearance 1 — object record Object number: SCP-354 Class: Keter An immobile pool of thick, dark red liquid. There is no clear boundary between the liquid and surrounding soil. Unauthorized approach to the bank is dangerous.
LanguageData.SCP_354PartialReport: Clearance 2 — observation The liquid resembles blood in consistency but is not biological. It becomes denser with depth; no bottom has been found. Different entities emerge periodically. Most recorded instances were extremely hostile and tried to escape the area.
LanguageData.SCP_354DocumentedReport: Clearance 3 — containment and game adaptation Foundation records describe a fortified perimeter, surveillance and armed guards. The pool itself cannot be moved: defenses must be built around it. In game, the pool occupies 17×11 tiles. Hostile creatures start emerging several days after discovery. The open-world emergence remains simplified; the dedicated perimeter-defense assignment depicts several individually documented entities.
